faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIITDM Kancheepuram JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIITDM Kancheepuram is 20th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is M.E. / M.Tech. specialization in ECE or an equivalent degree. GATE qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the JRF position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the IIITDM Kancheepuram recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIITDM Kancheepuram located?
faq.answer: IIITDM Kancheepuram is located in Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600127.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the JRF position?
faq.answer: You can apply online for the JRF position through the official website of IIITDM Kancheepuram or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section of the official notification.
